verdicts.reason: Both use the same weak banner layout: the confetti is squashed into a meaningless speck cluster in dead space, the two owls are shrunk to tiny icons jammed together, and the brown owl's cone butts right against the 'K' of the title. In A, 'EVENT MANAGEMENT' wraps onto two lines at nearly title weight, which is clunky and competes with the headline. In B it stays on one line and reads more cleanly left to right, though it floats off on its own, far from the title it labels.
